milestones.description: Plan: 'Dig and set up with Brainstorm/Ponder/Consider' — rate a cantrip is cast when offered.
Plan: 'Protect the Doomsday resolution ... and Thoughtseize' — a discard spell strips the coast clear some turn before Doomsday.
Plan: 'power the pile with Dark Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Lotus Petal' — fast mana precedes Doomsday within the turn.
Plan: 'cast Doomsday to search out a 5-card library' — Doomsday ever cast.

Plan: 'Protect the Doomsday resolution and the payoff with Force of Will, Daze, Flusterstorm' and 'Never cast Doomsday without a mapped-out, protected win' — a protection spell visible in hand (hand is the only protection signal in the prompt; PLAN-hold measures keeping one up across turns).
Plan: 'win the same turn (or the next upkeep) by ... Thassa's Oracle ... or by ticking Jace, Wielder of Mysteries' — Doomsday then a payoff later.
Plan: 'drawing into and resolving Thassa's Oracle with an empty library' — a win payoff ever cast.

notes: Whether Doomsday was cast WITH protection is not directly extractable (the cast row and the hand snapshot are the same prompt, so protection_in_hand at the doomsday turn is the proxy); the pile contents are never visible.
